name: Seed Junky | Strawberry Daiquiri
description: Caffeine doesn't just wake you up, it electrifies your mind and flips the switch to hyper drive. Bright and fruity, it delivers a blast of sweet candy, like Fun Dip and Sweet Tarts, layered with tropical citrus, creamy lime, and a heavy gas finish that keeps the flavor loud all the way through. This strain doesn't creep. It hits fast and hits hard, launching you into a wired head high that feels electric, focused, and creatively charged Pertect for idea sprints, deep dives, or getting way too into your to-do list, Catteine keeps your mind moving and your senses lit.
